posts.text:
3% of a giant Western Australian forest died in a record drought in 2023-24. Now, scientists have used the damage to develop a surprising new tool for predicting future die-offs: gamma rays.🌲⚡ 

Read more in @science.org: www.science.org/content/arti... #tree #forest #drought #climate #climatechange
posts.external_title: To predict tree death, scientists tapped gamma rays to peer underground
posts.external_description: Airborne radiation sensors could help forecast and prevent drought-driven tree mortality

posts.text: Climate change is expected to alter oceanic circulation, with the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation at risk of collapse. A study in Nature Climate Change shows that the stability of the AMOC is dependent on the rate of atmospheric CO2 change rather than having a fixed threshold. 🌊🧪
posts.external_title: Failure to track a stable AMOC state under rapid climate change - Nature Climate Change
posts.external_description: Climate change is expected to alter oceanic circulation, with the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) at risk of collapse. This work shows that the stability of the AMOC is dependent on the rate of atmospheric CO2 change rather than having a fixed threshold.

posts.text: Europe’s rules for proving environmental performance of battery technologies could reshape sustainability regulation far beyond the European Union, researchers report in a new #SciencePolicyArticle. https://scim.ag/4zC4oKO
posts.external_title: A Brussels Effect for battery sustainability
posts.external_description: An EU battery regulation can help drive toward a widely shared evidentiary system for sustainability governance
